ggmtools 0.0.0.9000

Evaluation and inference helpers from the DiNA simulation

Method-agnostic helpers moved from the DiNA simulation (dina_simulation/04_calc_metrics.R, 00_helper_functions.R, tcga_demo/utils.R), with the overlapping versions in spikeyglass and multiGGMr merged into one.

  • New: pr_auc() (PR curve and AUPR; method = "trapezoid", "average_precision" or "interpolated"), topk_overlap(), bayes_fdr(), pooled_perm_pvalues(), relative_frobenius(), kl_divergence(), ggm_bic(), threshold_to_adjacency(), diff_adjacency(), upper_tri_to_matrix() and diff_edge_table().
  • confusion_at_threshold() also returns FDR and MCC.
  • confusion_at_threshold(), roc_auc() and pr_auc() accept vectors of edge scores and truths as well as p x p matrices.
  • stats added to Imports.

Old to new names:

Old New
DiNA compute_auc(truth_vec, score_vec) roc_auc(score_vec, truth_vec)$auc
DiNA compute_aupr(truth_vec, score_vec) pr_auc(score_vec, truth_vec)$auc
DiNA compute_tpr_fpr(truth_adj, est_adj) confusion_at_threshold(est_adj, truth_adj)
DiNA compute_fdr(TP, FP), compute_mcc(TP, FP, TN, FN) confusion_at_threshold(...)$FDR, $MCC
DiNA compute_relative_frobenius(est, truth) relative_frobenius(est, truth)
DiNA compute_kl_divergence(theta_hat, sigma_true) 2 * kl_divergence(theta_hat, sigma_true)
DiNA threshold_to_adjacency(theta, threshold) threshold_to_adjacency(theta, threshold)
DiNA XOR differential truth (.xor_truth() builds it) diff_adjacency(adj1, adj2)
DiNA pcor_from_precision(Theta) precision_to_pcor(Theta)
DiNA vBIC(X, est_graph, thr) ggm_bic(X, est_graph$theta, threshold = thr)
DiNA vec_to_pcor_mat(vec, p, gene_names) upper_tri_to_matrix(vec, gene_names)
DiNA extract_diff_edges(pcor1, pcor2, threshold, gene_names) diff_edge_table(pcor1, pcor2, threshold, gene_names)
DiNA bayes_fdr_call(), .bayes_fdr_call(); multiGGMr bayes_fdr() bayes_fdr(prob, alpha)
DiNA pooled_perm_pvalues(); spikeyglass .pooled_perm_pvalues() pooled_perm_pvalues(observed, null)

Behaviour differences from the old versions:

  • bayes_fdr() keeps tied probabilities together: the cutoff is placed only between distinct values, so the selection no longer depends on the input order. If a whole tie block would push the expected FDR above alpha, none of it is selected. Example: prob = c(1, 1, 0.9, 0.9, 0.9), alpha = 0.05 used to select 4 edges (two of the three tied 0.9s, chosen by position); it now selects 2. Results without ties at the cutoff are unchanged.
  • pooled_perm_pvalues() is spikeyglass’s version: a null value counts as an exceedance when it is within a relative tolerance (sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * max(1, |x|)) of the observed score. DiNA subtracted an absolute .Machine$double.eps, which vanishes for scores >= 2, so exact ties were then not counted. Example: observed 3 against the null c(1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4) gave p = 2/7 and now gives 5/7. Without ties the p-values are unchanged. It returns pvalue and p_adj (DiNA: pvalues, p_adj, upper_tri_idx; use edge_index(p) for the indices).
  • kl_divergence() returns the Kullback-Leibler divergence KL(N(0, Sigma) || N(0, theta_hat^-1)) = (tr(Sigma theta_hat) - log|Sigma theta_hat| - p) / 2. DiNA’s compute_kl_divergence() omitted the 1/2 (it is Stein’s loss), so its values are twice kl_divergence(); its comment also had the direction reversed. Rankings are unchanged. A singular theta_hat gives NA instead of Inf.
  • ggm_bic() equals vBIC() for valid input; it returns NA when an estimated precision matrix has missing values or a zero or negative determinant (vBIC() used log|det| and ignored the sign). It takes the list of precision matrices, not the fitted JGL object.
  • pr_auc() with the default method = "trapezoid" equals DiNA’s tie-corrected compute_aupr(). "average_precision" and "interpolated" (Davis-Goadrich) are new; the trapezoid is optimistic when a large tied block (e.g. edges at exactly 0) has lower precision than the edges above it.
  • precision_to_pcor() symmetrizes the result and returns NA with a warning for a non-positive diagonal; DiNA’s pcor_from_precision() kept asymmetry and returned NaN.
  • diff_edge_table() returns the shared edge-table columns i, j, node1, node2, est_g1, est_g2, diff in upper.tri() order. DiNA’s extract_diff_edges() returned gene1, gene2, pcor_group1, pcor_group2, diff, sorted by -abs(diff).
  • topk_overlap() counts the overlap of two top-k lists with ties broken at random in expectation. Taking order(...)[1:k], as DiNA’s plot_topk_overlap() does, breaks ties by position, which inflates the overlap of sparse methods once k exceeds their non-zero edges.

Initial version

  • Initial version. Collects the functions previously duplicated in spikeyglass and multiGGMr (precision_to_pcor(), confusion_at_threshold(), roc_auc(), plot_roc()), with one signature, plus the shared generics pip_table() and pcor_estimate(), the edge-table helpers edge_index() and as_pip_table(), and the brca_pi3k dataset.
  • roc_auc() handles tied scores correctly: the curve steps only at distinct scores, so the AUC equals the Mann-Whitney statistic. (multiGGMr’s previous version accumulated one edge at a time, so tied edges were ordered by matrix position.) It returns auc (lower case).
  • confusion_at_threshold() returns a list including precision and F1. Rates with a zero denominator are NA.
